title: Finalizing Austin Housing Developments & Bylaws
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors AHFC Meeting
summary:
*   The Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) convened to address key housing initiatives, temporarily recessing the City Council meeting.
*   The AHFC adopted updated bylaws to accommodate an 11-member board and appointed new officers, streamlining its governance.
*   Six previously discussed housing development projects received final approval, formalizing earlier City Council decisions and moving these projects forward.
